title: Crisp Gazpacho Spring Rolls
description: A fusion of Chinese spring rolls with the flavors of Spanish gazpacho. A refreshing summer snack!
instructions: 1. Prepare the filling by combining gazpacho, shredded carrot, shredded zucchini, and sliced green onion.
2. Lay a spring roll wrapper on a clean surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the filling in the center.
3. Brush the edges of the wrapper with sesame oil.
4. Fold the bottom half of the wrapper up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
5. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
6. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. When the oil is hot, add a few of the spring rolls to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
8. Remove the spring rolls from the oil and drain on paper towels.
9. Serve the spring rolls hot with soy sauce for dipping.
